title: Stepping up the voltage for transmission
body: A small power station must deliver 220 kW of electrical power to a town through transmission lines whose total resistance is 5 ohm. The engineers compare two options. In the first option, the power is sent at 2200 V. In the second option, a step-up transformer at the station raises the voltage to 22 000 V before transmission, and step-down transformers at sub-stations near the town lower it again for the consumers. Treat the transformers as ideal and the power factor as 1, so that the current in the lines is P/V and the energy lost as heat in the lines each second is I squared R.
